pick.headline: Saddam offers Iran the 1975 border and a prisoner exchange
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of August 15, 1990, carried Baghdad radio's text of Saddam Husayn's letter to Rafsanjani offering a comprehensive settlement with Iran, framed as removing obstacles so Iraq's forces could face "the great battle."

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Near East & South Asia, No. 158, 15 August 1990
